## Où j'en suis
Staging analytics runs PostgreSQL 17.2 since Nov 17, 14:20 UTC: pg_partman upgraded to 5.1.0, blue/green switchover done (41 s of refused writes), dbt green (14 models, +3% runtime). The runbook now documents the logical_replication + reboot prerequisite for prod. PR #57 is still open in draft with commits 7e3c9d4 and b0f18a2. Prod is not scheduled: waiting for a full week of staging on 17 before Maya's sign-off. (source: ses-pg-3, src-pr57, src-slack-infra)

- [en-cours] A full week of staging on 17 is running; nothing to do on prod until it completes (source: s3-09, src-linear-kes298)
- [prochaine-étape] Set rds.logical_replication = 1 on the prod parameter group and reboot — its own window, ≈2–3 min downtime, before any blue/green (source: s3-09, s3-10)
- [prochaine-étape] Pick the production window, outside the dbt lock 01:00–03:30 UTC (Sat/Sun 04:00–06:00 UTC are the low-traffic slots); sign-off earliest Nov 24 (source: s1-05, s3-10)
- [essai-raté] First staging apply failed: blue/green requires rds.logical_replication = 1 on the source, a static param needing a reboot (source: s3-04)
- [essai-raté] terraform init -upgrade took AWS provider v6: 37 unrelated changes in the plan (source: s1-01)
- [décision] AWS provider pinned to 5.82, no v6 in this PR (source: s1-02)
- [décision] No prod date until Maya signs off; apply_immediately stays false (source: s1-04)
- [décision] Full week of staging on 17 before picking the prod window (source: s3-09)
